inventory.credit: confirmed * observed_fraction * issue_time_weight * supported_anchor_fraction for a still-retained same-epoch key; zero otherwise
inventory.unassigned: 1-sum(eligible credits); no redistribution of lost/cutoff/missing mass
inventory.competing_interference: For each existing retained trace j, sum credits assigned to i!=j; unassigned mass adds none.
inventory.creation: Only positive credit from an actually rendered outcome creates a trace. Reading an inventory or an intended/unconfirmed action does not.
inventory.support_once: Timing bins carry raw anchor-support mass. Condition those bins on supported anchors when multiplying by credit, which already contains that support fraction.

timing.coordinate: (observed outcome time - frozen anchor time) / frozen issue-time period; modulo one only for periodic references
timing.timestamp_model: Independent uniforms on known observed hop supports. Mix frozen anchor alternatives by their retained weights. Missing intervals remain unsupported.
timing.integration: Exact CDF of the difference of two uniforms, with point-timestamp cases handled explicitly; integrate every bin, retaining multiple modes and linear overflow.
timing.lookup: The separately tested center interpolation includes overflow in the denominator; queries outside the linear range remain unsupported.

normalization.formula: softmax(log retained mass) over positive bins, including nonperiodic overflow; no pseudocount
normalization.zero_bin: zero probability; no numerical retrieval floor becomes a timing-bin pseudocount
normalization.empty_trace: unknown for action; only the stated assay may use its uniform initial prior
normalization.between_updates: A common extra wait or competing-interference increment cancels from normalized probabilities. Waiting alone does not identify tau or kappa.
normalization.necessary_design: Vary gaps/interference before later executed updates that change relative bin histories, and vary recurrence counts enough to activate the strength cap.

state_update.model_revision: Private retained assignment mass per bin, distinct from unchanged episode lifetime-strength renewal.
state_update.head_semantics: Only the actually observed onset/release head receives added mass. Both heads receive elapsed decay and competing-reference interference.
state_update.representation: f64 log masses; exact exponential times piecewise-linear timestamp-admission integration; numerical moments use a convergent series near zero.
state_update.order: sealed (observed support end, onset before release, stable outcome ID); duplicate or earlier keys rejected; repeated-ID reconciliation and delivery reordering remain upstream responsibilities.
state_update.overlapping_support: Integrate each known time interval, then use the declared endpoint order; do not infer a hidden within-hop event order.
state_update.capacity: Apply all fractional assignments together, then evict minimum total retained mass over both heads, stable reference-key tie break, until <=16 traces. Lost handles are removed without redistribution.
state_update.issue_prediction: Caller freezes probabilities at action issue. Returned before-update snapshots are diagnostics and must not replace an older issue-time prediction.

observation_law.scope: Conditional on a target head executing in a finite, issue-time opportunity window; this is an explicit assay law, not a model of failed execution or a live scheduler.
observation_law.baseline: Uniform physical time within the declared window; unassigned reference/anchor mass and geometrically inaccessible bin mass remain here, with no live action support.
observation_law.bin_lift: For each frozen anchor/period alternative, q_bin selects a bin; physical time is uniform on its intersection with the opportunity window. Linear overflow uses the union of both outside regions. An empty intersection uses the baseline for that whole bin mass.
observation_law.anchor_uncertainty: Integrate the original uniform anchor time and alternative weights after normalizing each bin intersection for that anchor. Missing alternatives remain baseline, never redistributed onto survivors.
observation_law.physical_mixture: One arithmetic mixture over reference densities using issue-time z; unassigned z uses the same baseline. An empty trace head uses the declared 32/33-bin assay prior, staying unknown for live action.
observation_law.observation: For disjoint known intervals R_j and fixed detection d_j, P(Y=j)=d_j*integral_R_j p(t) dt; the last category is missing detection, including acquisition gaps.
observation_law.fitting: One categorical log-likelihood term per probe, including missing detection. Future result coverage o or credit r does not reweight or redefine the issued prediction.
observation_law.learning: The same one actually detected physical outcome updates every eligible trace with its frozen fractional r; no per-reference independent draws or posterior-responsibility reassignment.
observation_law.numerics: Complete 32/33-bin column-stochastic kernels. Integrate affine overlap-length ratios analytically across anchor breakpoints, with a convergent near-constant-denominator series.
observation_law.original_soft_bin_score: Retained only as a coverage-qualified composite diagnostic, not as the fitting likelihood.
observation_law.required_empirical_checks: Prespecified windows, body/policy feasibility, actual acquisition-aligned timing and waveform-derived references; a window violation is a reported protocol failure, not silent exclusion.
